posts.title: Speculative Parallel Rejection Sampling in ML-DSA Signing
posts.description: Speculative Parallel Rejection Sampling in ML-DSA Signing ML-DSA signing uses the Fiat-Shamir with Aborts construction. The signer picks a random masking vector y , computes a candidate signature, checks norm bounds, and either accepts or discards and retries.
